Matthew Arnold, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/matthew-arnold/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Matthew Arnold, the author and annotator, died 1888.
- Humphrey Sumner Milford, the annotator, died 1952.

First publication of the text used: between 1840 and 1891 (SE colophon: 'Poetry includes poems published between 1840 and 1891 by Matthew Arnold.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published between 1840 and 1891, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so it entered by 1986.
- Country of origin (possible countries: the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths. The last to die did so in 1952, so the text entered the public domain in each of these countries on 1 January 2023.
